value.rationale: Latz's published mean-square sufficient cutoff \(ah<1\) does not settle exponential decay of individual sample paths. The exact model-specific Ei threshold \(ah\approx2.68451\) quantitatively shows a broad window with a.s convergence but exploding mean-square, signed mean and, above \(ah>1/\log2\), all positive integer moments. Complete real-order threshold and critical path classification provide a sharp benchmark for random-clock integrator stability beyond straightforward mean-square assertions. The scalar restriction and classical random-product tools are disclosed.
